paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.27% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.09%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.96%). Brent crude changed +0.03% to 98.32. Gold changed -0.94% to 4,074.8999. Bitcoin changed -0.04% to 75,714.7891. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.859%, a relative move of +0.45%. Among the firms tracked, Franklin Templeton (+4.72%) and Deutsche Bank (-4.34%) moved the most.
